title: Krull--Gabriel dimension and Cohen-Macaulay representations
summary: Let $R$ be a complete Cohen--Macaulay local ring and $Λ$ an $R$-order. We study the Krull--Gabriel dimension of the functor category $\mathrm{mod}\,\underline{\mathcal C}(Λ)$, where $\underline{\mathcal C}(Λ)$ is the stable category of maximal Cohen--Macaulay $Λ$-modules. This work is motivated by the non-existence theorem of Herzog and Krause for Krull--Gabriel dimension $1$ over artin algebras.
